title: Premier Relationship Manager (Rajkot)
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Wealth and Personal Banking serves more than 50 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and protect and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Wealth and Personal Banking-Overseas Indian team.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **Premier Banking** team.

**Job Introduction**

As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager or Corporate Executive Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans.

You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions.

Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Business Impact:**

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products

**Client Management:**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration:**

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence:**

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development:**

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements:**

**Knowledge & Experience**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Industry Experience:
* + GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of relevant experience.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licences and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

**Pro-tip :** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.*

*As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Property Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

RED | Real Estate Domain (KW RED) is the first market center to partner with KW Egypt, operating as a respected real estate brokerage known for integrity, professionalism, and client-focused service. The company has built a strong industry reputation by prioritizing transparent transactions and long-term relationships. A dedicated team of experts supports clients in achieving their real estate goals through data-driven decisions and innovative technology. By adapting to changing market dynamics, RED consistently delivers exceptional results and seamless real estate experiences. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for clients across all their real estate endeavors.

**Role Description**

The Property Consultant is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This position focuses on guiding clients through the property buying, selling, and leasing process, including conducting property viewings, preparing and presenting offers, and supporting negotiations. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining a portfolio of listings, researching market trends, and providing informed recommendations to help clients make data-driven decisions. The Property Consultant will handle client inquiries, build and maintain strong relationships, and ensure a professional and seamless experience from initial contact through closing. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams, using real estate technology tools, and meeting agreed sales and performance targets.

**Qualifications**

* Strong consulting skills to assess client needs, provide tailored property advice, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent communication abilities for clear presentations, negotiations, and relationship-building with clients and colleagues.
* Proven customer service capabilities to ensure a responsive, professional, and client-centric real estate experience.
* Sales experience, including lead generation, pipeline management, and closing transactions in a competitive market.
* Foundational real estate knowledge of local market trends, property valuation, legal processes, and documentation.
* Ability to work on-site in Cairo, Egypt, with strong time management, organization, and attention to detail.
* Comfort with using real estate CRM systems and digital tools to track leads, properties, and client interactions.
* Relevant academic background or professional certifications in real estate, business, or a related field are advantageous.
* Fluency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken, is highly beneficial.

Our teams are inclusive and diverse. Our colleagues work together and celebrate together. If you want to advance the world of fintech, wed like to ask you: Are you FIS 
 About the role: We are looking for a motivated and technically strong Software Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using modern Java technologies and cloud-native architecture. This role involves designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable applications while working closely with senior engineers, architects, and product teams. The candidate should be passionate about continuous learning, software craftsmanship, modern development practices, AI-assisted development, and building distributed systems that are secure, reliable, and performant. About the team: Position Manager team is working on below daily activities Data import from Exchange and BO (Exercise, Assignment, Settlement, Market data, closeout, final position spread) Reconcile final positions, Exr/Asns between exchange BO Reconcile top day trades Closeout the position at exchange Position closeout, Client Stock notifications What you will be doing: Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot. Build and consume RESTful APIs and microservices. Develop integrations using Apache Camel and enterprise integration patterns. Participate in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Deploy and manage applications on AWS or Microsoft Azure. Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, deployment, and release processes. Containerize applications using Docker and deploy them to Kubernetes environments. Monitor application health, logs, and performance in cloud environments. Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms using modern Identity Providers (IdP) such as Azure AD, Okta, Key cloak, Auth0, or similar solutions. Integrate applications with enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions using OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML protocols. Ensure compliance with security best practices and enterprise standards. Configure and manage API Gateway solutions. Develop integrations with message brokers and MQ platforms. Design and implement event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, Azure Service Bus, Amazon SQS/SNS, or similar platforms. Build resilient and scalable asynchronous processing workflows. Analyze application performance and identify bottlenecks. Optimize APIs, database interactions, JVM settings, and system resource utilization. Participate in troubleshooting production issues and root cause analysis. Implement observability, monitoring, and logging best practices. What you will need: Bachelors degree or the equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience. Good to have Investment banking experience Derivates markets experience. Experience - 1-3 Years only Location - PUNE Only Good written and verbal communication skills. Candidate should be flexible to support business in extended hours. Good knowledge in AWS, Azure Cloud. Quick learner and proactive in handling additional tasks. Fluent in English Excellent communicator ability to discuss concerns and issues with other support team. Good to have knowledge of large language models such as ChatGPT, Claude, Agentic AI workflows and intelligent automation solutions. Good to have knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers for AI tooling and enterprise integrations to improve productivity and customer experience. What we offer you:
 At FIS, you can learn, grow and make an impact in your career. Extensive Health Benefits Program along with the Family Protection Plan Best-in-class career mobility options across the globe Award-winning learning offerings for career development Adaptable home - office work model Opportunity to collaborate with global teams and clients.
